name: scroller
need: Let a wide strip or a tall column scroll on its own with edge fades, a reel of cards, and float a jump pill in a log

--ds-scroll-fade.description: the length of the edge fades of `.ds-scroll-x`, `.ds-scroll-y`, the table wrappers and the cut edges of menus, combobox lists and drawer lists (2.1); `0px` turns every fade off

--ds-scroll-reel-item.description: the width of each child of `.ds-scroll-x--reel`

--ds-scroll-reel-gap.description: the gap of `.ds-scroll-x--reel`: the base, 2px less per density step

physical..ds-scroll-x: mask-image: gradient direction: the edge fades follow the sideways scroll
